purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a material-allocation dispute below Ti'asantatca's outer-road Stormshield station.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the provisioning landing, ordinary issue work, the central recall, the labor-and-promise classification dispute, final release, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the empty landing geometry, worker introductions, each choice layer, the arriving order, each fold that changes the visible account, the final threshold, and each ending family. The order-board arrival and the moment the Circle's narrower operational message reaches the stair receive distinct frames.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt restates the visible landing geometry, materials, light, people, and props needed for that frame. Specialized objects are described in ordinary visual language. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints and are excluded from assembled prompts.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, strong readable silhouettes, storm-muted blue-gray stone and cloth, warm amber lamplight, restrained magical ambiguity, expressive work-worn faces and hands, abstract unlettered record marks, cinematic framing designed for playable story screens.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every image prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups actually visible under the current trigger, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Exclude absent refs and all visual_continuity_notes. Use the scene_set camera and staging coordinates as geometry authority.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one landing from several controlled angles and moves sacks, tally halves, the store bar, bowls, and witnesses across folds. The embedded measured layout defines fixed geometry, cameras, routes, and staging slots for every frame.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For higher visual consistency than the structured layout diagram alone provides, translate these coordinates into a simple blockout with the same camera ids and use image generation as the painterly pass.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide empty establishing view of a roofed stone provisioning landing beneath a high-fantasy storm station. A broad arched cart entrance fills the east wall, hung with a heavy waxed storm curtain breathing inward. Immediately south of the arch, a grated floor drain and raised wooden slat rack hold dark wet marks. Four barred dry-store bays line the north wall, each with a different simple geometric clay marker above it. A waist-high timber tally bench stands in the center between arch and store, covered with paired fired-clay pieces on pegs. A narrow dry stair rises from the northwest corner to a warm recovery room above. A small iron shortage clapper hangs on the arch jamb. Cold blue-gray storm light enters from the arch and meets amber oil-lamp light over the bench; sacks, folded stormcloth, lamp-fat jars, bowls, and one raised stair shelf make the supply uses physically distinct.
visual_continuity_notes: The landing is a 9 by 6 metre rectangle: east cart arch, southeast drain and rack, north four-bay store, northwest dry stair, central bench, clapper on the east arch jamb.
Clay marks are abstract impressed shapes and not readable modern writing.
The Stormshield itself is not shown as a visible glowing dome.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable visual identities for recurring named characters and conditional groups. Include only refs for bodies visible in the rendered frame.

characters.seni_var: Seni Var: sturdy human woman in her late thirties with umber skin, square face, broad nose, two short blunt horn nubs at the hairline, dark hair wrapped close in brown cloth, alert dark eyes, and strong wax-stained hands. She wears a moss-brown wool work coat with rolled sleeves over an undyed tunic, clay-red tally sash hung with geometric fired-clay pieces, dark loose trousers, and dry leather foot wraps. Her silhouette is upright behind the bench; judgment appears through exact hand placement and an economical raised eyebrow.
characters.pera_oth: Pera Oth: stocky human woman in her sixties with deep brown skin, rounded face, broad nose, silver hair fully contained by a cream head wrap, and powerful forearms. She wears a saffron quilted vest, cream work tunic, dark green apron with bowl cloth and spoon loops, loose trousers, and soft dry wraps. Her silhouette leans into practical care; she usually carries clay bowls, a runner token, folded cloth, or a covered ration.
characters.kalo_rei: Kalo Rei: lean human man in his twenties with copper-brown skin, long face, broad nostrils, one small horn nub at the right temple and a smooth left hairline, rain-dark curls, and watchful hazel eyes. He wears a grain-dusted brown tunic, slate-blue woven shoulder cloth, narrow belt with waxed household tally packet, close work trousers, wrapped calves, and mud-dark boots. His silhouette bends under sacks but straightens beside named household evidence.
characters.aru_venn: Aru Venn: tall human woman in her forties with dark brown skin, smooth hairline, narrow tired face, long black braid, and precise black eyes. She wears an indigo waxed storm cloak over a fitted ochre store coat, dark divided work skirt over leggings, high leather boots, and carries a square fired-clay order-board with abstract impressed marks. Her silhouette is long and forward-moving; urgency appears as a squared stance, raised order-board, and clipped pointing hand.

groups.landing_witnesses: Landing witnesses: a small mixed group of adult household carriers, station attendants, and upper-stair workers in rain-dark wool cloaks, undyed tunics, aprons, wrapped calves, and work boots; varied human faces and physiques, some with small horn nubs and some with smooth hairlines; hands carry baskets, bowls, folded cloth, or clay tally halves. They stand along the stair and arch edges while keeping the central sack route clear.
